note: Laws in force on 1 January 2000 (gameplay mapping). Elections are competitive but restricted by Guardian Council vetting of all candidates. The economy is classed as state capitalism because of the dominant state oil sector and large state-linked foundations. Broadcasting is a state monopoly while a sizeable private reformist press existed in 1999-2000, hence state-influenced rather than state-controlled media. Internet filtering was not yet systematic in 2000, so the internet is 'regulated' rather than 'filtered'. Men are subject to compulsory military service.
